name: Cloudflare Workers AI

freeTier.note: Workers AI includes a daily free allocation measured in 'Neurons' rather than tokens, and the day rolls over at 00:00 UTC. Neuron consumption per model is not predictable from token counts, so this provider is tracked in requests plus provider-reported errors, and its token quotas are left UNKNOWN by design.

notes: Uses the account-scoped OpenAI-compatible surface. Model discovery hits the account model search endpoint and degrades to an empty catalogue with an explicit warning if the token lacks permission, rather than inventing a model list.
